title: Consolidate existing engineering task registration
scope: Use the existing task catalog for admission, policy associations, serial authority checks, model/patch descriptor lookup, fixed-test selection and capability metadata.
riskAnalysis: Pure server-owned registration refactor. Historical request objectives, descriptors, serialized policies, source/test bindings and public capabilities remain unchanged. No added grant, execution, publication or customer access.

threatModel.assets: Historical task/source identities, serialized policy hashes, isolated-test profiles, serial execution and current owner authority.
threatModel.trustBoundaries: Untrusted assignment and patch data to authenticated server task catalog, then existing authorization and fixed-test consumers.
threatModel.abuseCases: Unknown objective or forged profile grants execution; caller mutation alters trusted catalog; historical objective becomes fresh admission; circular import bypasses checks.
threatModel.mitigations: Exact server objective lookup, isolated returned copies, preserved task-specific source validation, explicit historical admission and independently compared old-source compatibility.

rollback: Revert this feature-branch refactor and restore the qualified nonpaid8255952 Preview alias. Retain every historical receipt and financial record. No Production changes.

negativePaths.malformed-response: Existing native malformed response and patch validation fixtures remain unchanged and fail closed.
negativePaths.stale-state: Historical source and descriptor hashes remain exact; fresh source availability and release checks stay in consumers.
negativePaths.concurrency: Existing serial authority lifecycle and controller CAS tests remain; registry creates no executable state.
negativePaths.cancellation: Native controller cancellation, revocation and cleanup integration tests remain intact.
negativePaths.worker-interruption: Native test/worker and failed persistence fixtures preserve cleanup and honest failed evidence.
negativePaths.api-outage: No network access added; existing provider failures remain subject to controller diagnostics and shutdown.
negativePaths.authorization-denial: Unknown, edited, forged task/profile metadata produces no registration, policy or test capability.
negativePaths.spending-limit: Existing monitor-only financial policy and historical accounting are unchanged; catalog is not spending consent.
negativePaths.partial-execution: Existing five-stage fixtures retain Auditor rejection and qualified failed-test evidence without acceptance.

defects.rootCause: Admission, provider policy selection, serial lifecycle and fixed-test routing separately registered the same engineering objectives.
defects.detectionGap: Each consumer could be updated independently when adding or revising a task, leaving another consumer stale.
defects.regression: 19pre-refactor route snapshots plus actual old-source independent comparison, mutation/unknown tests and native five-stage integrations.
defects.historicalPrevention: One existing server-owned catalog supplies task recognition and associations; historical policies and descriptors retain exact serialization.

proactiveReview.architecture: Extend existing implementation-tasks module; no competing controller, journal, provider or new task registration service.
proactiveReview.dependencies: No dependency installation, provider change, credential or execution image change.
proactiveReview.threats: Catalog data cannot issue authority; owner, exact runtime/source/task, test permission and publication checks remain in consumers.
proactiveReview.failureModes: Unknown tasks remain unknown, historical Starter objectives cannot gain fresh admission, and source-changed descriptors remain unusable.
proactiveReview.faultInjection: Forged assignments/profile fields, mutated copies, unknown versions and historical route compatibility are tested alongside native cancellation/cleanup.
proactiveReview.independentChallenge: Separate QA and Auditor approve efd78485; each25tests passed. QA compared actual old Git source and Auditor tested six import orders.
proactiveReview.recovery: No paid model/count call or test VM. Existing qualified nonpaid8255952 Preview remains rollback target; historical authority stays revoked.
proactiveReview.readiness: 180focused/integration tests passed. Required full STRICT will run once in hosted CI with Redis, CodeQL, Jekyll and actual authenticated Browser evidence before live use.
